name: Dalma

name: Chhena Poda
description: Chhena Poda – A baked Odia cottage-cheese dessert, traditionally made for festivals and celebrations.

name: Khar

name: Masor Tenga

name: Chila

name: Bafauri
description: Bafauri – Steamed Chhattisgarhi lentil dumplings, a common everyday snack tempered with mustard seeds.

name: Kafuli
description: Kafuli – A Kumaoni Uttarakhand curry of spinach and local leafy greens, eaten as a daily household dish in the hills.

name: Jhangora Kheer
description: Jhangora Kheer – A barnyard-millet pudding from Uttarakhand, eaten as a regular dessert rather than only on festivals.

description: Axone Chutney – A pungent Nagaland fermented soybean condiment eaten alongside rice and vegetables.

description: Mui Borok Chicken – A traditional Tripuri chicken preparation cooked with minimal oil and local herbs.

name: Thukpa
description: Thukpa – A hearty Tibetan-influenced noodle soup popular across Arunachal Pradesh and Sikkim, especially in colder months.

name: Gundruk Soup
description: Gundruk Soup – A fermented leafy-green soup from Sikkim, a light daily household dish in the hills.
